method.scope: quarterly Form 13F data sets (SUBMISSION, COVERPAGE, SUMMARYPAGE, INFOTABLE); held names only; context, no signal, no score
method.long_only: rows with PUTCALL set are excluded (no hedges shown); only SSHPRNAMTTYPE = SH counts; values as reported (whole dollars for periods from 2023-01-01, thousands before, scaled)
method.one_filing_per_manager_quarter: the latest RESTATEMENT amendment replaces the original 13F-HR; NEW HOLDINGS amendments are added; the disclosure date is the latest filing date used
method.top_holders: the 10 largest holders by shares at the latest quarter-end; share change against the same manager's prior-quarter filing (prior shares null when the manager has no prior filing in the data sets loaded)
method.new_and_exits: new positions: held now, not held (or no filing) in the prior quarter; full exits: held in the prior quarter, current filing shows none; both restricted to managers whose TABLEVALUETOTAL for that quarter is at least $1000000000
method.no_current_filing: prior holders without a current-quarter filing are listed apart, not as exits
method.shared_discretion: shares reported by more than one manager under shared discretion are not de-duplicated
method.cusip: derived from INFOTABLE: majority CUSIP (by distinct filings) among rows whose NAMEOFISSUER starts with the company's core name, class hint applied; provenance under cusip_map
method.caption: positions as of {quarter_end}, disclosed {date}; long positions only; no hedges shown.
